name: King's Valley
comment: King's Valley (1985, RC-727). setMusic @ 0x7AA9 takes the id in A (0x80 = music stream); the per-frame player is 0x7B36 and can run without the game. Music ids start at 11 (2 channels) and 17/20/23/26/29 use 3 (the table at 0x7CF5 holds one pointer per channel). Reset addresses 0xE012/0xE01E/0xE02C are the per-channel current-song bytes; the driver ignores a lower-priority song, so they must be cleared first. Mapping taken from the annotated disassembly (github.com/GuillianSeed/Kings-Valley).
